c.title: $4,800 / 3br - 3-Bedroom House in a Great Location – Collingwood & 12th (Kitsilano)
c.description:
Spacious 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom house located near Collingwood Street and West 12th Avenue in a convenient Vancouver neighborhood.

The house is just 3 blocks from Broadway and approximately a 10-minute walk to Jericho Beach. Several bus routes are within walking distance, including the #2, #7, #14, #9, and #99, providing convenient access to UBC, downtown, and other areas of Vancouver.

The house features:

3 bedrooms
2.5 bathrooms
Kitchen
Living room
Full basement
Laundry room
Back deck
Front and back gardens
A great option for a family or responsible tenants looking for a spacious home in a well-connected neighborhood close to shops, transit, and the beach.

Pictures are attached.
